blind.description: A low, rounded decorative bush composed of dense green foliage and numerous glossy bright-red berries clustered throughout the leaves. The foliage consists of stylized overlapping leaves arranged in a domed shrub, resting directly on the ground without an artificial base or soil slab.
blind.from_above: A rounded circular mound of green leaves dotted evenly with bright red berries, showing a slight natural hollow in the top center.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 1.8 feet tall (roughly one-quarter to one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet in diameter.
